title: A question that evidence can answer
outcome: Explain a question that evidence can answer using the records and boundaries of this fictional investigation.
scenario: A question with a measurable answer. A team wants to know whether giving a diagram changes accuracy on six fixed plant-identification tasks.
given: Candidate questions: "Are diagrams wonderful?" and "Does version B answer more of these six tasks correctly than version A?"

steps.label: Narrow the question
steps.detail: Name versions A and B, the six tasks and correct-answer scoring.

steps.label: Define the comparison
steps.detail: Use the same tasks and labels with and without the diagram.

steps.label: Bound the conclusion
steps.detail: The study can compare those versions on those tasks, not all diagrams or learners.

explanation: An answerable research question connects a change to an observable outcome and a specified population. Opinion words need an operational definition before measurement.

counterfactual.change: Replace the six tasks with six easier tasks only for B.
counterfactual.prediction: The comparison no longer isolates the diagram condition.
counterfactual.reason: Task difficulty now changes alongside the proposed intervention.

student_task: Which proposed diagram question has a measurable outcome? Name its versions, six-case denominator and fixed scoring, then explain why giving only B easier tasks spoils the comparison.
teacher_answer: Name versions A and B, the six tasks and correct-answer scoring. Use the same tasks and labels with and without the diagram. The study can compare those versions on those tasks, not all diagrams or learners. Changed case: The comparison no longer isolates the diagram condition. Task difficulty now changes alongside the proposed intervention.
project_evidence: For the Reproducible AI Research Study, retain an annotated worked trace and the changed-case reasoning. Connect the claim to its records, units and assumptions so another investigator can challenge or reproduce it.
limits: This fictional study does not establish effects on children or general classroom learning.
review_note: Individually authored fictional practice distinct from the reserved independent case. No invented significance, real experiment execution or pupil outcome is asserted.
